example_sentences_in_bangla: চাকরির বোঝা তাকে ক্লান্ত করে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The family responsibilities weigh heavily on his shoulders.
The burden of the job has exhausted him.
note: Commonly used in the context of family duties as 'সংসারের বোঝা', reflecting traditional Bengali views on familial roles.
